quote.quote_773de4268f: As the self-proclaimed king of the Freljord's icy wastes, he mercilessly defends his territory from anyone who crosses the invisible boundary line that only he truly knows.
quote.quote_0ccac88f2e: After his tribe was slaughtered, he swore vengeance as its sole survivor, and ever since his fury raging across the battlefield has been so fierce that not even death can get a hold on him.
quote.quote_239345013a: No one knows for certain where he came from in Bilgewater, only that with equal ease he honors or robs blind anyone who sits down at the table with him, whether with his cards or his luck.
quote.quote_c34170a7cd: He ekes out his life deep in Zaun's sewers, venturing out only to take revenge on all those who once hunted and despised him as vermin.
quote.quote_0fc017c921: As one of Freljord's spiritwalkers, he carries the souls of four different animals within him, and his life's purpose is to finally find peace among the clashing forces raging inside him.
quote.quote_10fa778151: As Noxus's former merciless executioner, he served his superiors, until they betrayed him and cast him into Zaun's deepest cesspit, from which he returned a twisted monster, thirsting for revenge.
quote.quote_81141a4a0a: Three Ionian hunters swore to destroy a darkin weapon, but in the end they themselves became its captives, and now share a single body of arrows between vengeance and damnation.
quote.quote_4e67c03378: One dark night a demon murdered her family, and from that day her only purpose remained: to wipe out every monster lurking in the shadows for as long as she lives.
quote.quote_470b89e01b: An innocent curiosity set him on the path of studying dark magic, until, despite his tiny stature, he became one of Runeterra's most feared sorcerers.
quote.quote_64bcf23f65: As one of the Void's scholarly entities, he wants nothing but to understand every piece of Runeterra, even if that means taking apart whatever he examines into tiny fragments.
quote.quote_daa42e8ba6: She comes from a gloomy corner of Bandle City, where everyone else is considered unhappy and suspicious, especially those who seem too cheerful for her taste.
quote.quote_4d7a001faa: She grew up on the streets of Zaun's slums with a younger sister she tried to protect above all else, until an explosion tore them apart from each other forever.
quote.quote_bcc1a36949: As the former king of the Blessed Isles, after his wife's death he turned to forbidden magic to bring her back to life, but instead unleashed a devastating curse upon his entire kingdom.
quote.quote_948c7f12ec: He rose out of Zaun's poverty with the conviction that true progress meant trading the body's frailty for mechanical parts, sparing no one who stood in the way of achieving it.
quote.quote_215458130b: For centuries he has lived on, rejuvenated by blood magic, weaving his web of influence through Noxus's upper circles, never satisfied with however much power he already holds.
quote.quote_65f393a9fd: One of Freljord's ancient storm gods, he does not believe civilization and the wild could ever coexist peacefully, and so does everything he can to see the old order restored.
quote.quote_93cb6863b6: Deep within Zaun he was twisted into a monster by the experiments of those who wanted to punish criminals, but instead he forged even his own hunger into a weapon against the city's most wicked inhabitants.
quote.quote_c92c721702: As a wandering Ionian monk he walks the roads with a staff in hand, because his master taught him that true strength lies not in power, but in the path one walks.
quote.quote_7872851df3: Because of her people's gradual disappearance she took up arms against those she believes responsible for the vastaya's extinction, while her partner instead tries to keep the memory of their old culture alive as a performer.
quote.quote_b3c1044de7: As one of Shurima's ancient mages, his thirst for power saw him sealed within an urn for millennia, and now that he has broken free, he tries to rebuild the old empire with a body turned to pure energy.
quote.quote_7e75ce1e5a: He saved the prince's life in a Demacian battle, and out of gratitude and honor has since sworn to remain the royal family's protector until death.
quote.quote_3a25d71451: He was accused of murdering his master, though he was innocent, and has since walked Ionia's roads as an exile, hoping that one day he will find the true killer and clear his name.
quote.quote_8d288f798d: He died in battle at his own half-brother's hand, but death would not let him rest: he returned wearing a demonic mask, seeking answers to what he never understood in life.
quote.quote_ae78def5c5: As the Blessed Isles' last gravedigger, he calls upon the dead and spirits, using their aid to hold back the destructive tide of the Ruination that long ago swallowed his home.
quote.quote_efd30631df: She wandered as an abandoned spellbook-cat, until she found a companion again, and now, with a piece of her soul bound to them, she never feels alone.
quote.quote_341176bbfc: He rose to life from Zaun's toxic waste as a shapeless yet gentle giant, using all his strength to protect the city's less fortunate residents.
quote.quote_bea25ec9c9: He turned against his own former master to seize the secrets of forbidden shadow magic, and forged an order of warriors from that betrayal, one that strikes at its victims from the shadows ever since.
quote.quote_0fd998746f: During an industrial accident she became charged with electrical energy, and has since used that power to protect her home and family amid the tense relationship between Zaun and Piltover.
quote.quote_e77811bbfd: In Zaun and Piltover's scientific circles, no one shares his genuine enthusiasm for explosions quite like he does, designing every experiment to be a little louder than the last.
quote.quote_0985f80482: Since the destruction of his home and the loss of his love, he has been obsessively researching the secret of mastery over time, hoping that one day he can turn back the clock and prevent the tragedy.
quote.quote_851024124c: As the embodiment of a celestial being, she plays with mortals' lives through the power of whim and twilight, never truly considering what consequences her pranks might bring.
quote.quote_7d7a651d0f: Deep within Ixtal, she was reborn from a silenced nature spirit, armed with thorns and flowers, to take revenge on all those who once trampled the earth that had nourished her.
quote.quote_bc58c60e1e: In her unwavering devotion to Ionia, ... spent centuries cloistered away in the spirit realm, mastering the Aion Er'na, the legendary Kinkou relic. Whatever she has sacrificed, ...'s vow to free the land from discord and strife holds firm to this day.
quote.quote_15e45c2ad8: As a fallen god who wields both divine and profane power, ... hunts his fellow darkin, while defying the corruption that threatens to consume him. Once he willingly sealed himself within his blade to stave off madness; now he walks free — noble in heart, ruthless in deed.
